profile.headline: Senior Engineer | Stord
profile.summary: Experienced software developer skilled in Spring Boot/Java, and Angular. Strong consulting professional graduated from Georgia Institute of Technology.

positions.title: Software Engineering Team Lead
positions.description:
- Managed a cross-functional team of 6–8 direct reports, including backend and frontend engineers and SDETs, providing technical guidance and career development support.
- Led technical execution and cross-functional delivery on multiple high-priority initiatives under tight timelines, driving collaboration across engineering, QA, and product.
- Built strong partnerships with product managers, shaped realistic timelines and staffing plans, and offered candid feedback to improve delivery processes.
- Grew team capabilities through peer feedback cycles, technical goal-setting, and visibility of accomplishments; championed integration testing standards and strengthened QA–engineering collaboration.
- Contributed to team growth by leading candidate interviews and supporting hiring decisions.

Tech Stack and Tools: Kotlin, TypeScript, Kafka, MongoDB, Postgres, Spring Boot, Gradle, Github, Gitlab, JIRA, Moesif, Datadog, Kubernetes, GCP

positions.title: Senior Backend Engineer
positions.description:
- Led development of major third-party integrations, enabling critical roadmap delivery with no blockers from the W2G team.
- Designed and implemented a new Amazon fulfillment flow, overcoming platform constraints to allow customer orders to be fulfilled via FBA.
- Collaborated with external partners to co-design integration flows and represented Ware2Go in third-party meetings to align and deliver scoped requirements on schedule.
- Translated high-level business goals into actionable tasks, breaking down complex work and delegating effectively based on team members’ strengths.
- Improved system reliability by adding alerting and monitoring for warehouse data entry errors.
- Built polling strategies to supplement unreliable webhooks, ensuring consistent real-time order tracking.
- Migrated core backend systems from TypeScript to Kotlin, resolving longstanding technical debt and enhancing code maintainability and performance.

Tech Stack and Tools: Kotlin, TypeScript, Kafka, MongoDB, Postgres, Spring Boot, Gradle, Github, Gitlab, JIRA, Moesif, Datadog, Kubernetes, GCP

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Kotlin Developer -- June 2021 – Nov 2021
- Developed GraphQL queries and mutations for Kotlin-based UI API Orchestrator
- Coordinated between micro-service teams and frontend teams to determine ideal data schemas

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Java Developer -- Aug 2020-June 2021
- Created Spring Boot APIs for a fraud detection web application
- Led development of security for backend services using Spring Security
- Leveraged consulting acumen to solidify project requirements, uniting the needs of the product team, customer experience team, and tech team
- Conducted knowledge transfer sessions on completed work to new team members; mentored junior developers

Angular Developer -- Jun 2019-Aug 2020
- Developed a fullstack Tableau-integrated Proof of Concept to enable users to create notes linked to dashboard data points. The PoC leveraged JavaScript, Spring Boot, and JPA
- Drafted an MVP roadmap for the PoC and presented it to client stakeholders
- Served as Angular developer through the completion of the MVP and beyond, working alongside a visual designer and 4 other developers
- Led demos of the application to various stakeholders, including product owners, business leadership, and technical leaders for the client

Java Developer -- Apr 2019-Jun 2019
- Assisted with the architectural design and implementation of a Spring Boot microservice Proof of Concept for a case prioritization system
- Developed CRUD APIs utilizing Spring Data Repositories, JPA, and SQL Server
- Led containerization of the microservices using Docker, including startup and container networking
- Composed numerous technical documentation deliverables including solutions diagrams, readmes, and confluence pages

Test Automation Engineer -- Sep 2018-Apr 2019
- Utilized Selenium WebDriverIO to replace a 180 case manual regression test suite with a robust automated UI test suite
- Shortened regression process from multiple days to under 30 minutes, allowing releases to occur more frequently
- Created documentation for the transition of ownership of the automated tests, which included setup instructions and troubleshooting guides

positions.title: Product Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked on an agile product development team focused on a Workforce Management solution
•	Daily tasks included researching and prototyping new architecture, contributing to long-term feature projects, and writing integration tests
